dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: #Oh? Why, hello there! I thought you'd left, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: The energy readings around here have stabilized a great deal, thanks to you. When I go back and write my thesis, I will mention you for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: However, as the nominal employer of the exploration team, I will still need to stay for a long time to observe this place.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: Then I shan't keep you. Just know that you'll always be welcome with the exploration team!

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: Since you've helped me so much so far, I could tell you a few things, no problem.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: We came here to monitor the anomalous energies that have been radiating from deep below and study the effects they are having on The Chasm.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: It seems clear now, though, that the situation we face is far more complex than we first imagined.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: If it wasn't for your valor, I doubt that we'd have gotten anywhere near as much data as we have.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: Zhiqiong's condition has worsened. What on earth is she being so stubborn about, honestly...

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: I gave her some medicine. It should be able to at least slow some of the more serious symptoms, so her situation is stabilizing...

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: I'm no adventurer, and I can't claim to understand their desires, but I have no wish to watch someone else suffer before my eyes like this...

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: *sigh* Forget it. I hope she's more amenable to your logic.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: #Hello, {NICKNAME}! It's great to see you here.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: A field study, to record and research ancient life forms and their remains. Well, and I'm also here to observe the abnormalities in the geological layers.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And you're not going down there yourself?

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: Me? Go down there? No, of course not.

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: I mean, I did pay for this exploration team to be set up. I'll fork out the Mora, you do the work. My research gets done, you get paid. I'm happy, you're happy. See?

response.speaker: Khedive
response.text: Well, don't let me keep you too long.

dialogues.speaker: Khedive
dialogues.text: What a curious geological environment we're in now! I'm sure I can outdo the research goals set by the Akademiya this year.
